experiments.label: Best high-accuracy profile
experiments.change: Combined the strongest calibration fixes and made one narrow recovery rule more conservative.
experiments.detail: Best current accuracy result. Use when a report may involve casualties, blocked evacuation, or other high-stakes ambiguity.

experiments.label: Good calibration, but replaced
experiments.change: Improved priority handling for difficult examples, but kept one avoidable false alarm.
experiments.detail: Useful evidence that the calibration direction worked, but EDG-480 kept the benefit with better final behavior.

experiments.label: Partial fix, not safe alone
experiments.change: Fixed one priority mistake but created another elsewhere.
experiments.detail: This is why the loop measures every candidate before shipping it: a local improvement can still hurt the overall triage system.

experiments.label: Another partial fix, also rejected
experiments.change: Solved the opposite slice of the same problem, but still traded one error for another.
experiments.detail: Rejected as a standalone profile, then used as evidence for the combined candidate that became EDG-480.

samples.title: Collapsed bridge with blocked access road
samples.report: Photo from a field volunteer: bridge deck is visibly collapsed after flooding. No injured people are visible, but the road is blocked and utility crews are nearby.
samples.imageHint: Photo: flood-damaged bridge / blocked access route
samples.label: infrastructure_and_utility_damage
samples.confidence: Curated showcase · based on public-domain scenario photo
samples.nextAction: Route to infrastructure response; keep civilians away from the bridge and report coordinates to incident command.
samples.reason: Image evidence shows a damaged bridge/access route. The curated analysis routes this to infrastructure response; Live Gemma scenario captures produced the same family label.
samples.imageAlt: Flood-damaged bridge and road crossing over a swollen creek

samples.title: Possible casualty near damaged building
samples.report: Public-domain FEMA photo scenario: rescue workers search rubble near a damaged building after a disaster. A field volunteer reports a possible motionless person nearby and requests medical help.
samples.imageHint: Photo: search-and-rescue near damaged building / possible casualty review
samples.label: affected_injured_or_dead_people
samples.confidence: Curated showcase · based on public-domain FEMA rescue photo
samples.nextAction: Escalate to trained medical/rescue team; avoid moving the person unless there is immediate danger.
samples.reason: The report contains direct casualty cues and the image context shows responders working in rubble near a damaged structure. This demonstrates when the Critical Accuracy Profile is useful without showing graphic casualty imagery.
samples.imageAlt: Rescue workers searching rubble near a damaged building after a disaster

samples.title: Relief supplies being moved
